title: Studio
look_hint: Save the clothing from a good frame with the “save look” button under it and put it on in later frames.
show_prompt_hint: the model writes the prompt in parts — you tweak it and draw
discard_confirm: Discard the attempt? Its candidates will be deleted.

kind_hint.person: a figure in frame, face readable
kind_hint.action: a scene in motion: brawl, shootout, chase

view_hint.ship: the whole hull in frame, three-quarter view, from below
view_hint.handheld: one object in frame on a plain background
view_hint.structure: station, gate, wreck — black space all around
view_hint.planet: the whole globe on black, no horizon

register_hint.derelict: abandoned and never fixed: dust, frost, mold, dead consoles, torn-out cable looms, light only through a breach
register_hint.junk: scrap and rust: heaps of junk, stripped hulls, sheet-metal shacks and stalls, scavengers
register_hint.frontier: working space: painted armor worn at the edges, stenciled numbers, hangars and cantinas, everything works
register_hint.hightech: the Guilds and the core: designed and polished, hidden seams, hardlight, even light
register_hint.hegemony: power and order: dark alloy, ranks and formations, crests, cold light with red
register_hint.luxe: chosen, not issued: stone, heavy drapery, gold, tech hidden in the furnishings
register_hint.precursor: obsidian and dark iron, inlaid patterns, glow inside the material, human scaffolding on top

strength.replace_hint: the area is redrawn from scratch — a different object, a different face
strength.touch_up_hint: the source shape shows through — color, details, flaws

take_hint: take: its own face, pose and light
remember_look_hint: this frame's clothing becomes a look — you can put it on in later frames

err.describe: Describe what to draw — in text or by voice.
err.no_wear: The model didn't write out any clothing for this frame — nothing to save.
err.no_ask: Write what should appear in the painted area.
err.no_paint: Paint over the area that needs redrawing.
err.not_english: the model returned the edit prompt not in English — try again

dictation.unsupported: This browser can't recognize speech — type instead (Chrome/Edge can).
dictation.mic_denied: Microphone blocked — allow access in the browser settings.
